claims.text: The EU AI Act entered into force in phases between 2024 and 2027 because the phased entry was deliberate, designed to ensure that obligations land as institutional capacity and technology mature [Source: ev-1].
This schedule also serves as a compliance roadmap for providers worldwide [Source: ev-1].
The different deadlines require specific actions based on risk tiers and system categories. [Source: ev-1]
Specifically, from **2025-02-02**, prohibited practices (classified as "unacceptable risk") apply [Source: ev-1].
These include social scoring and certain manipulative or exploitation-of-vulnerability uses [Source: ev-1].
The evidence notes that the Act entered into force on 2024-08-01 but was published in the EU Official Journal on 2024-7-12 [Source: ev-1].
